edges.reason: releasedBalance branches and pro-rata math depend on block.timestamp.
terminate rewrites _releaseEndTime using block.timestamp.
Constructor validity check compares _releaseEndTime with block.timestamp.
onlyOwner compares the stored owner against _msgSender().
terminate is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
terminate is gated by the isNotTerminated modifier.
isNotTerminated and the final write read the _isTerminated state flag in terminate.
onlyOwner reads _owner through owner().
withdraw reads and updates the _withdrawedBalance accounting state.
The external token transfer is preceded by the _withdrawedBalance accounting update inside withdraw.
withdraw performs the external safeTransfer to the beneficiary.
withdraw consumes releasedBalance() to size the withdrawal.
releasedBalance scales _totalBenefit by the elapsed day ratio.
releasedBalance uses _releaseEndTime for the cap and total day count.
releasedBalance uses _releaseStartTime as the vesting origin.
withdraw calls releasedBalance() for its checks and amount computation.
withdraw calls token() to query the balance and perform the transfer.
withdraw sends the released amount to _beneficiary.
unreleasedBalance subtracts releasedBalance() from _totalBenefit.
unreleasedBalance reads _totalBenefit.
terminate rewrites _releaseEndTime to the truncated current day.
terminate reduces _totalBenefit to releasedBalance().
terminate sets _isTerminated to true.
terminate performs the external safeTransfer of the unreleased balance to the owner.
Constructor assigns the immutable _token.
Constructor assigns the immutable _beneficiary.
Constructor assigns the day-aligned _releaseStartTime.
Constructor computes and assigns _releaseEndTime.
Constructor assigns _totalBenefit.
Constructor initializes _withdrawedBalance to zero.
Constructor initializes _isTerminated to false.
Constructor calls _setOwner(_msgSender()) to initialize owner state.
_setOwner reads and writes the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership write to _setOwner.
renounceOwnership sets ownership to address(0) through _setOwner.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is only a data carrier into the constructor state assignment.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is only a data carrier into the constructor state assignment.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ is normalized and consumed entirely by the constructor schedule math.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ is consumed entirely by the constructor schedule math.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is only a data carrier into the constructor state assignment.
transferOwnership parameter newOwner flows directly into _setOwner for the ownership write.
Local amount is the value passed straight into the external safeTransfer call in withdraw.
Local amountToWithdraw is the value passed straight into the external safeTransfer call in terminate.
Local passedDays is an intermediate computed inside releasedBalance.
Local totalDays is an intermediate computed inside releasedBalance.
Local oldOwner is a transient snapshot of _owner inside _setOwner.
